identificationModule.briefTitle: Olanzapine for the Treatment of Chronic Nausea and/or Vomiting in Advanced Cancer Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: Olanzapine for the Treatment of Chronic Nausea and/or Vomiting, Unrelated to Chemotherapy or Radiation, in Advanced Cancer Patient - A Pilot, Dose-Finding Trial

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: There will be two groups for the study: Olanzapine Group will receive the study drug and Placebo Group will receive a placebo.

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Patients will receive the study drug or placebo in a double-blind fashion.

armGroups.label: Olanzapine
armGroups.description: Patients will receive 5 mg olanzapine orally for 1 to 7 days daily.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Patients will receive a placebo orally for 1 to 7 days daily.

interventions.name: Olanzapine
interventions.description: Olanzapine is used as an anti-emetic.
